release_notes:
RJD PisoWiFi System v3.14.25 - Production Release

⚡ 24/7 Pin 3 Hardware Interrupt Pulse Listening
- Fixed main coinslot pulse watching on Pin 3 (GPIO 12) for Orange Pi One / Raspberry Pi
- Kept sysfs epoll interrupt watching active 24/7 with zero CPU overhead

💰 Auto Revenue & Earnings Cloud Sync
- Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Yearly, and Total revenues auto-sync to cloud every 120s heartbeat

🛡️ Zero-Loss Backup & Restore
- Config, .env, and SQLite databases preserved automatically across all system updates

🎯 Pricing Rate Key Normalization
- Normalized all rate schemas for instant credit and time calculation
